source.track: Undergraduate · MIT Political Science introduction to international relations · lectures taught in order

note: Units follow the course's lecture sequence in teaching order: the Foundations block on frameworks, interests, interactions and institutions, then the Applications block on war, civil war and terrorism, trade and development, the environment, human rights and nuclear weapons. The foundations and bargaining-model sessions map to the foundational lessons; war, trade and environment sessions feed the intermediate lessons, and the human rights and nuclear weapons sessions carry the advanced lesson.
